topic: Countries that have hosted the most Olympic Games: United States 8 (Summer 1904 St. Louis, 1932 & 1984 Los Angeles, 1996 Atlanta; Winter 1932 & 1980 Lake Placid, 1960 Squaw Valley, 2002 Salt Lake City), with LA 2028 and Salt Lake City 2034 awarded (→ 10); France 6 (1900, 1924, 2024 Paris; 1924 Chamonix, 1968 Grenoble, 1992 Albertville); UK 3 (London 1908, 1948, 2012)
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

myths.myth: France or Britain, the old Olympic nations, have hosted the most Games.
myths.reality: France has 6 (3 Summer, 3 Winter) and Britain 3; the United States has 8 (4 Summer, 4 Winter), with Los Angeles 2028 and Salt Lake City 2034 already awarded.

claims.text: The United States has hosted 8 Olympic Games: Summer 1904 (St. Louis), 1932 and 1984 (Los Angeles), 1996 (Atlanta); Winter 1932 and 1980 (Lake Placid), 1960 (Squaw Valley), 2002 (Salt Lake City) — more than any other country.
vo: which country has hosted the most olympic games
france, united kingdom, or united states
united states. 8 games so far: 4 summer and 4 winter, from st. louis to salt lake city

claims.text: France has hosted 6 Games (Paris 1900, 1924, 2024; Chamonix 1924, Grenoble 1968, Albertville 1992); the United Kingdom 3 (London 1908, 1948, 2012).
vo: france is second with 6 in total, including paris. britain has 3, all of them in london

claims.text: Los Angeles will host the 2028 Summer Games and Salt Lake City-Utah the 2034 Winter Games, taking the US total to 10.
vo: los angeles hosts again in 2028, and salt lake city returns in 2034. that makes 10

claims.text: Los Angeles 2028 will make LA the third city to host three Summer Games, after London (1908, 1948, 2012) and Paris (1900, 1924, 2024).
vo: los angeles then becomes only the third city ever to host 3 summer games, after london and paris
